scope: Corollary 1.2 (Unipotent tensor squares) of the manuscript “Universal Tensor Squares for Symmetric Groups” (preprints/Universal-Tensor-Squares-for-Symmetric-Groups-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 205 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 822ceb3f2a80c935), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each positive integer n / ∈ {2, 4, 9}, choose a partition λn supplied by Theorem 1.1, including its finite-range witnesses. For every prime power q, let Uλ q denote the unipotent irreducible complex character of GLn(Fq) indexed by λ ⊢ n. Then Uλn q ⊗ Uλn q contains Uν q for every ν ⊢ n.
